Buttons.AdjustGridTitle: Calculates the number of grid squares and scene dimensions from the filename (e.g., 30x30)

Notifications.NoImage: No background image set for this scene.
Notifications.NoDimensionsFound: No grid dimensions (e.g., 30x30) found in filename: "{file}".
Notifications.LoadImageError: Could not load image to determine its dimensions: "{file}".

AutoResizeOnCreate.Name: Auto-Fit on Scene Creation
AutoResizeOnCreate.Hint: Automatically fits the grid and scene dimensions when creating a scene with an image that has dimensions in its filename.

AutoResizeOnUpdate.Name: Auto-Fit on Image Change
AutoResizeOnUpdate.Hint: Automatically fits the grid and scene dimensions when changing a scene's background image to a file with dimensions in its filename.

ScenePadding.Name: Scene Padding
ScenePadding.Hint: Proportion of extra margin padding around the map. 0 ensures the canvas ends exactly at the map borders.

FixedGridSize.Name: Fixed Grid Size in Pixels (Optional)
FixedGridSize.Hint: If 0, grid size is calculated automatically from the image resolution. If set (e.g. 100), forces all squares to that exact pixel size.

NotifyOnResize.Name: Show Notifications
NotifyOnResize.Hint: Shows a toast notification when a scene is resized.
